definitions.explanation: The head of the Japanese government, officially known as the Prime Minister of Japan. Formally selected by the Diet and appointed by the Emperor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{総理大臣|そうりだいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: A new Prime Minister has been chosen.

examples.japanese: {総理大臣|そうりだいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The Prime Minister held a press conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総理大臣|そうりだいじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議決|ぎけつ}→議決：15220_giketsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{指名|しめい}→指名：12868_shimei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japan's Prime Minister is nominated by a vote of the Diet.

notes:
USAGE:
The full formal title is {内閣総理大臣|ないかくそうりだいじん}. In everyday speech, ⟦{総理|そうり}→総理：13856_souri⟧ alone is the most common short form. ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧ is a near-synonym used more in news reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総理大臣|そうりだいじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take office as Prime Minister)
- {総理大臣|そうりだいじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to resign as Prime Minister)
- {総理大臣|そうりだいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{指名|しめい}→指名：12868_shimei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be nominated as Prime Minister)
